description: This file defines a Java interface 'CleanupCommandResponse' that extends 'CommandResponse', representing responses related to cleanup commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes constants for resource type and a nested class for JSON field definitions, focusing on cleanup command responses tied to a specific entity ID.

classes.name: CleanupCommandResponse
classes.description: An interface representing responses to cleanup commands, parameterized with a type extending itself.

classes.name: JsonFields
classes.description: A nested static class defining JSON field constants related to cleanup command responses, notably the 'entityId' field.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string for cleanup commands, which is 'cleanup'.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer corresponding to the resource path, which is empty in this default implementation.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the entity ID associated with the cleanup response, indicating which entity's snapshots and journal entries have been cleaned up.
